data.narrative:
Terra Industries is a Series A-stage defense and security company founded by Nathan Nwachuku and Maxwell Maduka that has raised $34M to date. Valuation analysis draws on a comparables universe of 10 private and 2 public peers in the Defense & Security sector, including Series B companies such as Dream Security ($3.0B), Harmattan AI ($1.4B), Code Metal ($1.2B), Castelion ($1.0B), and Defense Unicorns ($1.0B).

Two triangulation methods were applied. Stage-progression analysis uses the $34M total raised as a valuation proxy and applies a 2.0x step-up multiplier typical of Series A to subsequent-stage advancement, yielding $68M. Peer-median analysis across the 10-company comparables set produces a $1.0B median valuation, with a range spanning $125M (floor) to $3.0B (ceiling). The peer cohort skews toward Series B, reflecting limited Series A-stage public data in this sector.

The two methods triangulate to a valuation range of $58M (low), $534M (median), and $1.1B (high). The wide spread reflects material uncertainty in stage-equivalent positioning relative to the peer set. The stage-progression method implies more conservative near-term value, while peer-median reflects the elevated valuations currently observed in defense-tech. Key sensitivities include Terra's revenue traction relative to comparables, capital efficiency post-Series A, and sector funding momentum. Further diligence on operational metrics would narrow this range.
